_about: Family tree of the reel skills. tools/skills.js validates it and prints the tree; new-reel.js reads the engine from it. kind: engine (builds reels, owns an engine) | series (a reel template that extends a parent) | prompts (no code) | tool (works on the repo itself). Update this file whenever a skill is added, renamed, re-parented or versioned.

reel-creator.summary: 2D p5.js reels: a fresh art direction every reel (no house style), named styles on request, image-assisted mode

reel-creator-3d.summary: 3D Three.js reels: a fresh art direction every reel (no house style), cinematic camera, story lighting

reel-creator-2-5d.summary: 2.5D reels: p5.js-painted cards standing in a Three.js space, parallax and depth

educational.summary: Kinetic typography explainers: the words are the picture

storytelling.summary: Image-led stories: the 'with images' flow is on by default

ai-video.origin: built on the claude.ai account skill reel-visual-hook, 2026-10-30
ai-video.summary: AI video prompts and reel ideas only, never code

new-series.summary: Saves a new reel concept as a series template skill

skill-workshop.summary: Improves a skill, derives a child skill, syncs from claude.ai
